questions.text: A line $AB$ of length $80\,\text{mm}$ has its end $A$ $20\,\text{mm}$ above HP and $30\,\text{mm}$ in front of VP. The line is inclined at $30^\circ$ to HP and $45^\circ$ to VP. Draw its projections and find its apparent inclinations $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

A regular hexagonal pyramid of base edge $25\,\text{mm}$ and axis $60\,\text{mm}$ rests on one of its base edges on HP such that the axis is inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and parallel to VP. Draw its projections.

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Isometric Projections & Isometric Drawing from Orthographic Views
questions.text: Draw the Isometric View of a machine block from the given orthographic front view and top view.

A circular plane of diameter $60\,\text{mm}$ rests on HP on a point of its circumference with its surface inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP. The top view of the diameter passing through the resting point makes an angle of $30^\circ$ with VP. Draw its projections.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Section of Solids & True Shape of Sections
questions.text: A right circular cone of base diameter $50\,\text{mm}$ and height $70\,\text{mm}$ rests on its base on HP. It is cut by a section plane inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and passing through a point on the axis $30\,\text{mm}$ above the base. Draw front view, sectional top view, and true shape of the section.

A vertical cylinder of diameter $50\,\text{mm}$ is completely penetrated by a horizontal cylinder of diameter $40\,\text{mm}$ such that their axes intersect at right angles. Draw the lines of intersection (curves of intersection) in the orthographic views.
